events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Wishing Liam Gallagher a very Happy 54th Birthday. What's your favourite Oasis track or solo anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, and in the US on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Album
angles.copy: More than just a song, John Lennon's 'Imagine' album dropped 55 years ago this month. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the revolutionary click wheel? It's 25 years since Apple first introduced the iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Grab a martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon, born on October 9, 1940, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: From silly walks to hotel chaos, Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: A masterpiece of musical diversity! The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped 58 years ago this month. Which track from its sprawling 30-song collection is your go-to?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: The world remembers Freddie Mercury, the legendary Queen frontman, who passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a true icon. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul' – an album that pushed boundaries and redefined pop music. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: The world tragically lost John Lennon on December 8, 1980, when he was 40 years old.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the music world fell silent. Remembering John Lennon, whose legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on.
